description:
• Business Objects Universe and report design and development tasks. Assist with defining, documenting, designing and configuring reporting solutions
 • Creates, approves, and organizes Business Objects Universes used to support WEBI and Analytical reporting. Ability to work in a highly collaborative environment with minimal supervision.
 • Troubleshoot Business Objects Reporting issues. Aggressively work all issues through resolution. Work with internal support team to resolve difficult issues as needed.
 • Assist in the management of the Business Objects platform.
 • Provide input to project planning, status and review meetings.
 • Demonstrate the capabilities of the Business Objects platform to groups of people. Clearly articulate the functionality and advantages of the platform
 • Perform unit and integration testing and participate in reporting validation and QA efforts as they pertain to reporting and data analytics
 


 • BS Degree CS or MIS or equivalent experience in related roles
 • Experience in Business Objects such as Design, Semantic Layers (Universe), Data Modeling, Web Intelligence (WEBI), Dashboard and Explorer
 • Knowledge of SQL with the ability to write complex SQL queries.
 • Understanding of Business Intelligence solutions: operational and analytical, strong knowledge of relational and multi-dimensional database architectures
 • Complete understanding around Business Objects ecosystem, framework, administration, maintenance and configuration skills
 • Should have hands on experience in solving technical challenges in Business Objects
 • Experience developing reports using financial data with Business Objects
 • Hands-on experience with data architecture and data analysis skill sets.
 • Working knowledge of Team Foundation Services 2012 is preferred
 • Demonstrated ability to use discretion and make sound decisions
 • Ability to excel in a collaborative and distributed team environment
 • Ability to work with a minimal amount of direction while being pro-active in keeping their management informed of project related issues
 • Ability to work under pressure
 • Ability to respectfully question ideas and share a point of view with others in support of the business requirements and needs
 • Ability to effectively communicate with various levels of employees ranging from entry level to senior leadership
 • Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time and shift priorities quickly
 • Experience working on an Agile/Scrum team preferred
 • Proven strong problem-solving skills, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis
 • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
 • Comfortable in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment, working across multiple projects simultaneously.
 • Must have the desire to work on new, innovative, cutting-edge technologies.
